description: One transaction by its 64-hex id: type, sender, recipient, amount, memo, epoch, timestamp, attestations and finality. Use it to explain a specific tx. Indexed copies first; a tx not yet indexed is fetched once from the network and cached. source (cache, index, node or archive), source_label and as_of say which copy and when it was read. For an answer's grading outcome use get_answer_receipt.
name: get_transaction
title: Transaction
